description.en:
Angela was my friend. I wanted to give anything to her, who I thought more precious than my own family. And I eventually turned Angela, a lowly aristocrat from the countryside, into the flower of the capital society. But it was betrayal that came back. She sold me and my family to become an imperial princess.

"…Did you have to go this far?"
"Because I wanted you to be unhappy. I wanted to take your whole life away."

But when I thought I had died under the guillotine, I was surprisingly back in the past.

"Oh, hello. My name is Angela Vito…"
"You're Angela! Nice to meet you. Everyone was waiting for you."

With a bright smile, I held her hands together again.

---
My best friend betrayed me! Born from a low-ranking noble family, Angela grew to be renowned for her beauty and grace, becoming the prized angel of society, all with my enthusiastic support. Yet beneath that glitz and polish, she was simply... evil. She used me and had me killed out of sheer spite in her quest to become the empire’s greatest woman. But unlucky for her, a magical gift from a dragon has given me a second chance at life. No longer blinded by her light, I’ll do all I can to stop her!
description.fr:
Angela était mon amie. J'aurai pu faire n'importe quoi pour celle que je considérais comme plus précieuse que ma propre famille. Et j'ai fini par transformer Angela, une humble aristocrate de la campagne, en la fleur de la société. En remerciement je n'ai reçu que mensonge et trahison. Elle nous a vendu, ma famille et moi, pour devenir une princesse impériale.

"…Fallait-il que tu ailles aussi loin?"
"Je voulais que tu sois malheureuse. Je voulais te prendre toute ta vie."

Et lorsque j'ai cru mourir guillotiné, je suis revenue dans le passé.

"Oh, bonjour. Je m'appelle Angela Vito…"
"Vous êtes Angela ! Ravie de vous rencontrer. Tout le monde vous attendait."

Avec un sourire éclatant, je lui ai de nouveau tenu les mains.

---
Angela est ma chère amie à qui j’ai donné tout mon cœur, et elle m'a remerciée... en me trahisant. Pour devenir princesse héritière, elle a détruit ma famille et m’a envoyée à la guillotine. Mais au moment de l'exécution, je suis remontée dans le temps comme par miracle pour me retrouver au jour de ma première rencontre avec elle. Cette fois-ci, je ne me laisserai pas faire: ce sera maintenant à mon tour la faire souffrir.

description.en:
Julianne is as close to perfect as it gets: she’s got looks, talent, and smarts. The only problem is she has terrible taste in men! That’s why her little sister Lilianne is doing everything she can to make sure she doesn’t end up with the wrong guy. However, Julianne’s suitors are quickly catching on that the way to her heart is through Lilianne’s sweet tooth! How far will Lilianne go to set her sister up with the right man? Who will be the sweetest suitor?

---
I was the only younger sister of the female protagonist in the reverse harem novel. In addition, I was exceptionally pampered by the female lead after waking up after being very sick. I used that to defeat the original inexcusable trash male leads who only hurt my sister…

‘Lili, how are you? Do you like cake?’

‘Lili is really pretty because she resembles her sister. Won’t you eat cookies? Please tell your sister that these were given to you by your wonderful brother.’

‘Would you like to eat this and go over there for a while? I have something to say to your uncle and sister.’

For some reason, the male lead candidates seem anxious to see me.

**

“I don’t play with ugly kids," the boy in front of me muttered with a deep frown.

What? Did you really just say that? I’ll show you what the real world is like.

I gently pulled the hem of my sister’s clothes and shook my head, “I hate him, so I hate the older brother who brought him.”

At the same time, Cedric’s face turned pale, similar to someone who had been sentenced to death.

The problem? He's reborn as Baalier Junior, a weak demon prince, after his realm was conquered! To make things worse, his attempt to escape somehow gets him enrolled as a student of the Royal Class in Gradias Temple, a prestigious human school.

In the midst of plotlines and political schemes, can this author keep his identity a secret and reach a happy ending?

description.en:
The archmage who ruled over a magic kingdom. One day, she was reborn as the youngest daughter of the empire!

"I'll just play along and pretend to be a baby. …But don’t you think you guys like me a little too much?"

They won't leave her alone. The youngest princess is tired today as well.

---
Princess Enisha's birth marks the start of the Hyperion Empire's prophetic reign. With her unfathomably cute face and a ceaseless supply of loyal servants, life is pretty great for the baby princess. There's just the small issue of her two psychotic-killer brothers and a war-hungry father who she must stop from driving the empire into ruin. Enisha's got a lot on her plate, between the constant flood of assassins trying to kill her and those pesky memories of her past life. But she's in no rush to return to being the powerful high mage of a magical kingdom. After all, being Hyperion's one great hope certainly has its royal perks. It's not easy being the empire's beloved princess, but these subjects will just have to do.

description.en:
In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

---
In a brutal, lawless medieval world where war and poverty reign, and twisted magic defies all reason, the captain of the guards grinds through another grueling day, pushing his battered body to the limit in a land where survival itself is a merciless test.
description.fr: Aaron se retrouve propulsé dans un monde médiéval fantastique peuplé d’ignares, où le droit du travail n'existe pas. L’infâme ordure des gardes du château Casserdic va devoir tout faire pour survivre dans ce monde de guerre, de magie, de pauvreté... et de démons. Sans oublier, bien sûr, d’éduquer ces abrutis médiévaux.
description.id:
Terlempar ke dalam cerita fantasi berlatar abad pertengahan?! Dengan kondisi dunia yang sangat kejam dan dikuasai perang, sihir, serta berbagai hal aneh lainnya, Aaron harus menjabat sebagai ketua tim penjaga. Mampukah Aaron bertahan hidup di masa ketika hukum dan pandangan moral masih sangat primitif?

---
Di dunia abad pertengahan yang brutal dan tanpa hukum dimana peperangan dan kemiskinan merajalela, Serta magic gila yang membantah segala akal sehat, Kapten penjaga melalui hari baru yang melelahkan lagi, Memaksa tubuh lelahnya di tanah dimana bertahan hidup pun sudah seperti ujian yang keji.
description.ko:
노동법도 없는 무식한 중세.
전쟁과 빈곤, 마법과 비상식이 지배하는 이곳에서
경비조장은 오늘도 뺑이를 친다.
description.zh-hk: 轉生到這個沒有勞基法可言的中世紀異世界，轉眼間竟然已經過了六年……即使身懷不凡戰力，亞倫依然屈居警衛組長一職。就算他不願踏入任何紛爭，在這個貧富交錯、魔法縱橫的世界裡，衝突依然會不請自來。就在看似平凡的某一天，詭異的護送行動強行開啟了冒險的序幕！

description.en:
Dark World, the game I, a thirty-year-old salaryman, had devoted my entire youth to. 

"What the fuck is this…"

When I opened my eyes, Dark World had become my reality. The pouring rain, dripping hot blood, and a cold blade. At the moment of my impending death, I came into this familiar world.
A school bus crashes into an alternative world full of monsters. Amidst the hopeless despair, only the protagonist's Chat AI works.

A hundred years after his death, the fallen swordmaster of the empire returns as young Ricardt and sets out on a journey to uncover the truth behind the war that consumed his first life.

'Amor descontrolado',
Un manga de comedia romántica japonesa enormemente popular con más de 10 millones de copias vendidas.
Estaba poseído como Kim Yoo-sung, un extra que no tiene mucho protagonismo en ese cómic que nunca había visto antes.

Pero este tipo, 
Resulta que eres un auténtico otaku que incluso hace cosplay, ¿no?
Para una vida cómoda libre de dudas 
Dominaré todo tipo de narices del amor y haré de extra otaku.

¿Pero por qué se activa el cliché de la heroína cuando estoy contigo?
Y no solo uno—esto sería problemático, ¿verdad?

description.en:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. 

Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him – even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. 

Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.
description.ko:
"나를 과거로 보내주시오."

가족도, 친구도, 삶도, 모두 잃었던 '검무극(劍無極)'의 복수를 위한 첫걸음이 시작된다.

I "transmigrated" into a world I'd never seen before.

For 30 years, I believed I was living in a classic fantasy RPG.
I became a war hero, retired, and thought I was finally about to see the ending.
But...

Those 30 years were only the prologue.
It turns out the real story is about an academy?

전쟁영웅이 되어 퇴역했고, 이제 엔딩을 맞이할 예정이었다.

description.en:
Heavenly Demons, Hunters, Giant Robots, Demon Kings, and Superhumans.

The strongest warriors from countless worlds gather in one place, with the survival of their respective worlds at stake.

In this battle for survival, where defeat means nothing less than the destruction of an entire world, the representatives of the “Ordinary World”—the only ones with no special powers whatsoever—are dragged into the conflict.

Just as they are about to be crushed by the overwhelming strength of monsters who exist far beyond normal standards, they are given an unexpected weapon.

[The abilities of your game character are being synchronized]

Can Shin Jahyeon and the representatives of the Ordinary World borrow the powers of their game characters, defeat the true strongest beings, and survive?

description.de:
Liese Estelle ist eine geniale Ärztin. Sie wird ungerechterweise zum Tode verurteilt, weil sie einen Rebellen behandelt hat, aber im Gefängnis hilft sie einer alten Frau, die sie ihr Leben noch einmal leben lässt! Beim letzten Mal führte der Tod des jungen Erben Erwan zu einer Rebellion. Dann muss ihr Ziel in diesem Leben die Gesundheit von Erwan sein!
„Niemand ist mehr auf Lord Erwans Seite als ich!“ - „Lauft! Na lauft! Ihr müsst Euer Immunsystem aufbauen!“ - „Esst dieses Kraut! Es ist gut für Euch.“
Dank ihr wird Erwan ein gesunder und kräftiger Erwachsener. Liese kann erleichtert ihre Position kündigen…
„Du sagtest, du stehst für immer auf meiner Seite.“ – „Wie könnte ich dich gehen lassen?“
Ähm... So war das nicht geplant?! Wird Liese kündigen können?
description.en:
Rita Estelle knows that Duke Erwan Cereus will fall ill and die, leading to a bloody rebellion. She knows this because she would've died in that rebellion had it not been for a kindly sorceress who sent her back in time. With her second chance at life, Rita seeks to use her medical genius to get close to Duke Erwan as a child and cure him. But the closer she grows to him, the more she suspects his sickness is caused by foul play. Can Rita save Erwan and the whole country before it's too late?
___
When the duke, who was in poor condition, suddenly died, the land fell into the hands of the rebels. In a short time, the rebellion was suppressed by the royal family, but… The point is that I, Lise Estelle, will be hanged for treason. “It’s not fair!” I’m simply the best doctor in the area. If that’s the case, I’ll become the duke’s doctor this time so there’s no rebellion, and I’ll make the duke’s heir healthy! “No one cares about you as much as I do. Therefore, you must definitely listen to me!"
description.fr: Condamnée à mort lors de la Fronde, Rita, médecin de génie, se croit perdue. Mais alors qu'elle donne son ultime consultation, on lui offre une seconde chance. Rita revient dans le passé, le jour de ses 13 ans, et décide d'entrer au service de la famille ducale afin de sauver le petit Lord et d'éviter la Fronde. La jeune médecin n'a plus qu'un objectif: découvrir la source des maladies inconnues qui affaiblissent cette famille. Mais les sauver ne sera peut-être pas seulement de l'ordre du médical!
description.id: Setelah Duke Erwan meninggal, terjadi pemberontakan di wilayah kekuasaannya. Rita, seorang dokter berbakat dijatuhi hukuman mati karena mengobati pemberontak. Namun saat dipenjara, ia bertemu dengan seorang nenek yang mengirimnya kembali ke masa lalu. Akhirnya, Rita berencana mencegah pemberontakan dengan menyelamatkan Duke Erwan. Akankah misi Rita berhasil, dan apa yang terjadi dengan Duke Erwan?
description.ko:
영지 최고의 실력을 자랑하는 의사, 리체 에스텔.

반란군을 치료했다는 이유로 억울하게 투옥되지만,
그곳에서 한 할머니를 치료해준 보답으로
다시 한 번 생을 살 수 있게 되었다!

과거 반란의 원인은 소공자 에르안의 급사.
그렇다면 이번 생의 목표는 '소공자를 건강하게!'

"저만큼 에르안 님을 위하는 사람은 없어요!"
"뛰세요! 뛰시라고요! 면역력을 길러야 하니까!"
"이 풀 드세요. 몸에 좋은 거예요."

덕분에 에르안은 건강을 넘어 건장한 성인이 되고
리체는 마음 편히 사표를 내지만…

"너는 유일하게 나를 위하는 사람이라고 했잖아."
"내가 어떻게 너를 놓을 수 있겠어?"

어랏? 이게 아닌데?!
리체는 과연 퇴사를 할 수 있을까?!
description.pt-br: Lize Stelle, uma médica que possui as melhores habilidades da região. Ela é presa injustamente por tratar os rebeldes, mas em troca de tratar uma velha senhora, ela conseguiu uma nova chance de mudar o presente! A causa da rebelião no passado foi a morte repentina de Ethan, o pequeno príncipe do ducado. Então, o objetivo desta vida é ‘deixar o pequeno duque saudável!’ “Ninguém se importa com Ethan tanto quanto eu!” “Corra! Corra! Você precisa aumentar sua imunidade!” “Coma esta erva. É bom para o seu corpo.” Graças a isso, Ethan consegue ir além da saúde e se tornar um adulto forte. E Lize se demite com facilidade, mas… “Você disse que era a única que estava lá para mim. Como posso deixá-la ir?” Hã? O que é isso?! Lize poderá renunciar?!

It requires a six-person team. After a class project forces Yeong, her best friend Hana, and four unlikely teammates together, Yeong learns about the challenges of teamwork. But when the prize money doubles, the mismatched group decides to enter, sparking drama and unexpected bonds. Will they find success -- and maybe something more?

description.en:
Gyo-ha becomes a disciple of the Kunlun Sect, which was once numbered among the legendary Nine Sects and One Gang. Together with his fellow disciples, he struggles against all odds to rebuild the fallen sect.

...Except, something is a bit off.

Is this… really an orthodox sect?

description.ko:

원작 소설 속, 잔인하기로 유명한 남주 카르디셀이었기에  
싹수부터 다를 거라고 덜덜 떨며 그를 봤는데, 이게 웬걸? 

머지않아 피폐물 남주가 될 내 아들이 너무 귀엽다.

description.th: พอลืมตาขึ้นมา ฉันกลับกลายเป็นแม่พระเอกนิยายจอมเสเพลไปซะแล้ว เพราะเขาคือพระเอกที่โด่งดังด้านความโหดร้ายในนิยายต้นฉบับ เคยมองเขาอย่าง อย่างตื่นเต้นและคงไม่แตกต่างอะไร 'อร่อยจัง!' แก้มที่เพลิดเพลินไปกับการกินขนมหวานนั้นกลมดิ๊ก 'ไม่เป็นไร ผมเดินไปได้!' ฉันได้เห็นภาพที่ต่อให้เขาล้มจนเจ็บตัว ก็เช็ดน้ำตาแล้วลุกเดินไปอีกครั้งอย่างมั่นใจได้ 'ทำยังไงดี...' ลูกชายที่จะกลายเป็นพระเอกนิยายจอมเสเพลช่างน่ารักจริง ๆ หลังจากนั้นฉันก็แอบเตรียมอะไรให้เขากิน เอาใจใส่ และเขียนจดหมายให้เขา ทว่า "ไม่ต้องมาใจดีกับผม! ถึงทำแบบนั้นไปผมก็ไม่ต้องการแม่อยู่ดี!" ดูเหมือนว่าลูกชายจะไม่ชอบฉันมากกว่าที่คิด
description.uk:
Я стала Шеріелю, матір'ю головного героя роману "Пустка без крові та сліз". В оригінальному романі головний герой, Кардісель, був відомий своєю жорстокістю, тому я дивилася на нього з трепетом і очікувала на людину про яку читала, але що ж це? Мій син, який незабаром стане головним героєм, такий милий.

З 1 по 26 розділи редагуються!!

"Ми не можемо дозволити, щоб така мила дитина виросла людиною, яка ув'язнює і завдає шкоди головній героїні!"
description.zh:
我的孩子是变态？！
乖宝宝养成计划启动!
在我睁开眼睛时，成为了冷血无情的虐心小说男主的妈妈“谢丽尔”。原作小说中，他是以残忍闻名的男主卡尔迪斯，因此我以为他一定是从小就残忍，所以十分害怕地看向了他。可这是怎么回事？我这个不久后会成为虐心小说男主的儿子实在是太可爱了。“不能让这么可爱的孩子长成囚禁并伤害女主的人!”
description.pt-br:
Quando abri os olhos, me tornei Sheriel, a mãe do protagonista masculino do romance "Asas rasgadas". No romance original, o protagonista masculino, Cardisel, era famoso por ser cruel, então olhei para ele com receio, pensando que ele seria diferente desde o início, mas o que foi isso? Meu filho, que em breve se tornará o protagonista masculino, é tão fofo.

“Não podemos deixar uma criança tão fofa crescer e se tornar uma pessoa que aprisiona e prejudica a protagonista feminina!”

As climate catastrophe renders Earth uninhabitable, humanity sets its hopes on a new world: Arcadia. After years of deep-space slumber aboard the Atalante, crew member Dong Youngsoo finally awakens to a long-awaited paradise. But Arcadia is no Eden.
The planet is under siege by alien invaders, and a native civilization fights desperately for survival. Caught between worlds, Youngsoo is thrust into a harrowing adventure that could reshape the fate of an entire species—and redefine what it means to call a place home.
description.pt-br:
Com a catástrofe climática tornando a Terra inabitável, a humanidade deposita suas esperanças em um novo mundo: Arcádia.
Após anos de sono profundo a bordo da Atalante, o tripulante Dong Youngsoo finalmente desperta para o tão aguardado paraíso.
Mas Arcádia não é o Éden que esperavam.
O planeta está sob ataque de invasores alienígenas, e uma civilização nativa luta desesperadamente para sobreviver.
Preso entre dois mundos, Youngsoo é arrastado para uma jornada angustiante que pode mudar o destino de toda uma espécie — e o significado de chamar um lugar de lar.

description.en:
Agnes Saint is a princess with a reputation for cruelty and an unhealthy obsession with the dashing Captain Raymond. But when her personality changes overnight, it baffles everyone around her. The secret? The soul of a fangirl replaced Agnes in the middle of the story. Now, fueled by a stan’s unslakable love, she’s turned her eye to Kylo Grey, a side character with humble origins and her number one bias. Can she rewrite Agnes’ story to ship herself with the man of her dreams?
___
I’ve been reincarnated into a novel with my living and breathing bias.
Now I’m an Imperial Princess, who is known by all sorts of epithets, Agnes Saint!

It’s great that she’s filthy rich and a royal and all, but there’s just one problem…
the hateful trash who just insulted by bias’s very existence is none other than ‘me.’

Regardless, I’m here now and…
I will do anything, and everything, within my power to prevent my bias’s death and ensure he experiences nothing but smooth sailing going forward!

I would never wish for Kylo, my kitten, to suffer any sort of shock.
That’s why I have to hide my fervent adoration.
Besides, nothing good would come from revealing my stanning anyways.
So, for the time being, I’ll be perfect at… 

‘stanning in secret.’
description.es: Una ávida lectora de la novela “Splash infinito” muere atropellada por un “error de sistema”, según le informa una diosa. Para compensarla por el pequeño descuido, le ofrece una nueva vida en cualquier mundo que ella desee, real o ficticio. Sin pensarlo dos veces, la lectora sabe exactamente lo que quiere: conocer a su personaje favorito de “Splash infinito”, Kylo Grey. Pero, obviamente, renace como el personaje que peor relación tiene con Kylo, la princesa Agnes Saint. Para colmo, Agnes tiene una reputación espantosa en todo el imperio. Nuestra lectora tiene un doble desafío frente a ella: rectificar su mala fama de a poco para no levantar sospechas y, además, hacer todo lo posible para mejorar su relación con Kylo y vivir el tórrido romance que siempre se ha imaginado. ¿Lo logrará?
description.fr: Agnès Saint est une princesse connue pour sa cruauté et son obsession maladive pour le fringant Capitaine Raymond. Mais lorsqu’elle change soudainement de personnalité du jour au lendemain, tout le monde autour d’elle est déconcerté. Son secret ? L’âme d’une fangirl a pris la place d’Agnès en plein milieu de l’histoire. Désormais guidée par un amour inébranlable de fan, elle jette son dévolu sur Kaylo, un personnage secondaire aux origines modestes et son coup de cœur ultime. Parviendra-t-elle à réécrire l’histoire d’Agnès pour se mettre en couple avec l’homme de ses rêves ?
description.id: Seorang fangirl garis keras karakter villain bernama Kylo Gray masuk ke cerita yang disukainya! Namun, saat tersadar, kenapa dia malah menampar Kylo? Terlebih, berkali-kali?! Ternyata dia terlahir kembali sebagai karakter yang membenci Kylo, Agnes Saint. Apa yang akan dilakukan fans nomor satu Kylo ini pada takdir barunya?
description.ko:
최애가 살아 숨 쉬는 소설로 환생했다.
각종 수식어로 불리는 제국의 황녀, 아그네스 세인트로!

일단 돈 많은 황족인 건 좋은데...
최애의 인격을 모독하던 혐성 쓰레기가 바로 '나'라는 게 문제였다.

그래도 이왕 이렇게 된 이상...
기필코, 반드시, 어떻게 해서든 최애의 죽음을 막고 그 앞에 꽃길을 깔아주겠다!

나만의 아기 고양이, 카일로가 놀라는 건 결코 원하지 않았다.
그러려면 이 애끓는 마음을 당분간은 숨겨야만 한다.
게다가 원래 덕질을 밝혀서 좋은 건 없다. 그러니 당분간은 완벽하게...

'일코'한다.
description.ru:
Переродиться в романе, где живет мой любимый персонаж.
Самая красивая женщина континента. Любимая драгоценность императора. Королева светского общества. Бомба замедленного действия.
Я стала принцессой Агнес Сеинт, которую и называют всеми этими титулами и именами. Приятно быть частью богатой королевской семьи, но…
Как Драко Малфой, презирающий магглов в Гарри Поттере, так и «я» была ненормальной стервой, которая оскорбила моего любимого персонажа. И что еще хуже — она безнадежно влюблена в другого мужчину.
«Мой любимчик — Кайл, соперник главного героя, чьей ненормальной фанаткой я и переродилась…»
Но теперь, когда все в моих руках… Я любой ценой, любыми способами предотвращу смерть моего любимого персонажа и застелю его путь цветами! Но если бы я вдруг раскрыла себя как фанатка Кайла, все бы решили, что я сошла с ума. Он бы посчитал, что я чокнутая! Я вовсе не хочу, чтобы мой котенок был так шокирован. Поэтому пока что я должна скрывать свою мучительную привязанность. Тем более, что раскрытие того, что вы фанат, никогда не заканчивается ничем хорошим. Поэтому на данный момент идеально будет… «Держать все в тайне».
description.th: เมื่อฉันได้เข้ามาอยู่ในนิยายที่เมนของฉันมีชีวิตและจับต้องได้ แถมยังได้มาเป็นเจ้าหญิงที่มีฉายาพ่วงสารพัดอย่าง แอกเนส เซนต์ อีกต่างหาก! การเป็นเชื้อพระวงศ์ที่รวยล้นฟ้าแบบนี้มันก็ดีอยู่หรอก แต่ปัญหาก็คือ... ตัวตนของฉันดันนิสัยเสียและเคยดูหมิ่นเมนของฉันนี่น่ะสิ! ในเมื่อฉันได้มาอยู่ที่นี่แล้ว ฉันจะต้องหยุดยั้งความตายของเมนฉันให้ได้และจะทำให้เส้นทางของเขามีแต่กลีบดอกไม้ไม่ว่าจะต้องแลกมาด้วยอะไรก็ตาม! ฉันไม่อยากให้ไคโล ลูกแมวน้อยของฉันต้องตกใจ ฉันจึงต้องเก็บซ่อนตัวตนจริง ๆ องฉันเอาไว้ และต้องตีเนียนให้ถึงที่สุด... ฉันจะต้อง 'คอสเพลย์เป็นคนธรรมดา' แล้วละ!
description.zh: 身为追星女的我重生到小说里， 竟成为拥有各种头衔的帝国皇女？！ 但最喜欢的角色因为原身的侮辱而讨厌我， 就算这样……我也要阻止他的死亡。 看来要想做到这一点，就必须暂时暂时完美地“伪装”一下！
description.zh-hk: 重生穿越到了本命角色活著的小說世界， 成為具有各種代名詞的帝國皇女，阿格涅絲．塞因特！ 能當有錢的皇族是很好… 但問題是侮辱本命角色人格的人渣就是「我」。 不過既然如此… 我絕對、一定要想盡辦法阻止本命角色的死，替他開闢一條花路！ 我實在不希望我的專屬小貓卡伊羅受到驚嚇， 如果想做到這樣，就必須暫時隱藏這份焦急的心情。 而且表明自己在追星沒什麼好處，所以要暫時完美地… 「偽裝」。

description.en:
A tiny kitten dropped into a family of fierce dog beastmen — a heartwarming struggle for survival and growth!

Hong Seol, a cat beastman abandoned by her parents for being unable to use inner power, meets a miserable end… only to wake up moments before her death, having returned to the past.

“You are the child I have been searching for. Would you like to learn martial arts from me?”

With nowhere else to go, Hong Seol accepts the hand extended by the terrifying dog beastman clan, the Namgung Family’s Supreme Elder, and enters the Namgung household to survive.

‘If they find out I’m a cat beastman, I’ll be thrown out for sure!’

Completely unaware of Hong Seol’s constant anxiety, these dog beastmen keep wagging their tails and flocking around her every single day.

Well… all except one.

The prickly eldest dog beastman, Namgung Baek.

비참한 죽음 뒤 다시 눈을 떠보니 죽기 직전으로 회귀해 있다.

홍설은 살아남기 위해 남궁세가로 들어간다.

'고양이 수인이라는 사실을 들키면 쫓겨나고 말 거야!'

description.ru: Хонсоль -- кошка-оборотень, брошенная родителями из-за неспособности использовать внутреннюю энергию. После ужасной смерти она вновь открывает глаза и оказывается в прошлом незадолго до своей гибели. «Ты — тот ребёнок, которого я искал. Хочешь научиться у меня боевым искусствам?» Оказавшись в безвыходном положении, Великий Мастер грозной семьи собак-оборотней, клана Намгун, протягивает Хонсоль руку помощи, и она вступает в клан Намгун, чтобы выжить. «Если они узнают, что я кошка-оборотень, меня выгонят!» Не подозревая о постоянном страхе Хонсоль, словно она ходит по тонкому льду, эти проклятые псы каждый день приходят к ней, виляя хвостами. За исключением одного -- первого пса, вечно недовольного Намгун Бэка.

description.en: My fiancé just broke off our engagement, but I'm done crying over pathetic guys. I don't need a man to lead me to victory—I'll find my happy ending on my own! I've been trapped in a fantasy dating sim for three years and still haven't reached a good ending. After all, it's hard to win when I'm Serdel Loeveste, a forgettable side character. In this next playthrough, I'll have to take more risks instead of simply doing what I'm told. Will I finally be able to escape the game this time?
description.id: Sudah 3 tahun sejak aku masuk ke game ini sebagai karakter bernama Serdel Loeveste. Untuk kembali ke dunia asliku, aku harus mendapatkan happy ending. Namun, aku tidak bisa mendapatkan happy ending dan gamenya tereset. Aku kembali di saat ketika salah satu dari pemeran utama laki-laki di game ini, Hersh Meiant, memutuskanku. Aku sudah muak. Kali ini aku tidak akan memohon-mohon kepadanya! Aku akan membuangnya dan merencanakan happy endingku! Aku tidak akan gagal lagi!

게임 속으로 들어온 지 3년. 엔딩을 맞지 못해 리셋되고 말았다.
그런데 하필 돌아온 시점이 망할 남주 중 한 명에게 파혼당하는 순간이 뭐람…!
구질구질하게 매달릴 생각, 정말 없다고!

“더는 실패하지 않아.”

주변에 휘둘리던 한심했던 모습을 벗어 던지고, 앞으로 나아가기로 했다.
두 번째 삶을 비틀기로 하자 게임 속 남주들이 그녀에게 관심을 보이기 시작했다.

게다가 필요에 의해 원작에서 목숨을 잃었던 캐릭터를 살려주자, 그마저 세르델에게 집착하기 시작하는데…! 

“저를 버리지 마세요, 아가씨.”

과연 세르델은 무사히 엔딩을 맞아, 게임에서 벗어날 수 있을까?
description.ru:
Прошло три года с тех пор, как я присоединилась к игре. Я не смогла дойти до конца и в итоге вернулась в прошлое. Но почему, черт возьми, я должна была вернуться именно в тот момент, когда меня бросил один из ужасных главных героев...! Я не намерена жалко цепляться за него, правда!
"Я больше не потерплю неудачу".
Я решила оставить позади жалкий образ человека, на которого влияют другие, и двигаться дальше. Как только я решила изменить свою новую жизнь, главные мужские герои игры начали проявлять ко мне интерес. Более того, когда в силу необходимости я спасла персонажа, который в оригинальной истории должен был погибнуть, даже он стал одержим Сирдель...!
"Пожалуйста, не оставляйте меня, мисс".
Сможет ли Сирдель благополучно дойти до конца и выбраться из игры?

description.ko:
무림 천하오대세가 중 하나인 <남궁세가>의 둘째 아들인 남궁서휘는 가족과의 불화로 집을 뛰쳐나가고 5년 만에 돌아온다.
아버지와 형인 남궁서윤에게 상처 주는 일을 서슴지 않고,
작은 실수를 했다는 이유로 시녀에게 칼을 휘두르려 했을 정도로 망나니였던 서휘는 가출 후 만난 낭인에 의해 혈교에 팔려가고,
그곳에서 있던 비밀 실험의 실험대가 되고, 폭발 사고로 이세계인 <신성 가이아>의 라플레시아 대륙으로 가게 된다. 
그 세계의 15년을 살게 되지만, 신성 가이아의 인과율에서 벗어난 존재였던 서휘는 성장하지 않은 채로 이세계에서 살아간다.
이세계에서 서휘는 소중한 친우를 만나게 되고, 엄청난 수준의 마법을 부리는 강력한 힘을 지니게 된다.
또한 그 15년의 경험을 통해 망나니였던 15세와는 전혀 다른 성숙한 내면을 갖게 된다. 
그렇기에 무림의 시간으로 5년 만에 돌아온 서휘는 5년 전과 다르지 않은 외모를 지녔음에도 불구하고 전혀 다른 성격으로 아버지와 형에게 응석을 부리기도 하고,
식솔들에게 예를 갖추는 모습을 보여 남궁세가의 사람들을 놀라게 만든다.
그러나 그 내면에는 자신에게 적의를 드러낸 사람들을 주저 없이 죽일 수 있는 잔혹함을 지니고 있으며,
상대방을 철저하게 굴복시켜 무릎 꿇게 만드는 흉포함이 감춰져 있었다. 순진하고 어리게만 느껴지는 서휘를 지키려는 남궁서윤이지만,
서휘는 그런 형이 알지 못하도록 뒤에서 남궁서윤과 집안의 적을 철저하게 제거한다.
이세계인 라플레시아 대륙에서 자신의 친우인 아스밀리온을 황제로 만들 만큼 강력한 남궁서휘가 이번에는 무림에서 자신이 뜻하는 바를 펼치게 되고,
무림은 강력한 이형의 힘을 사용하는 서휘로 인해 크게 움직이게 된다.

description.ar:
من الاستوديو ذاته الذي قدّم أعمالاً لافتة ومميزة، تنطلق قصة بايك يانغ-هوي، الرجل الذي شق طريقه حتى انتزع لقب أعظم سياف متجول بفضل براعته الاستثنائية ومهارته التي لا تضاهى. لم تكن الموهبة عائقاً أمامه يوماً، إذ امتلك منها ما يكفي لبلوغ القمة، لكن مشكلته الحقيقية كانت في عائلته: عشيرة بايك المجهولة التي ترزح في أدنى طبقات عالم موريم، ولا يكاد أحد يمنح اسمها أدنى اهتمام. غير أن يانغ-هوي يقع ضحية كمين مميت، ثم يفتح عينيه على مفاجأة لا تصدق، إذ يجد نفسه قد عاد إلى طفولته وهو في الثامنة من عمره، حاملاً فرصة نادرة لاسترجاع المجد الضائع لعشيرته. مستنداً إلى ذكريات معاركه السابقة وخبرته الهائلة وموهبته الفريدة، يبدأ يانغ-هوي بتحطيم كل من يتجرأ على اعتراض طريقه. وهذه المرة، لن يسمح لنفسه بتذوق الهزيمة، ولن يقبل بأقل من أن يجعل اسم عائلته يدوّي في أنحاء العالم باعتبارها أقوى عشيرة تحت السماء.
____
من نفس أستوديو ذي قدم لكم: و رغم أنه انتزع لقب أعظم سيافٍ متجولوا لم تكن مشكلة يوماً في موهبة بايك يانغ-هويوا بل في عائلته “عشيرة بايك” مغمورة تي تقبع في قاع موريم. بعد سقوطه في كمينٍ قاتلوا يستيقظ يانغ-هوي ليرى نفسه طفلاً في ثامنة من عمره بفرصة ذهبية لإعادة أمجاد عشيرته. بذكريات معاركه سابقة وموهبة لا نظير لهاوا يسحق يانغ-هوي كل من يقف في طريقه. هذه مرةوا لن يُهزموا ولن يقبل بأقل من جعل اسم عائلته يتردد في أرجاء ع م كأقوى عشيرة تحت سماء!
description.en:
“As expected of the Best Sword of Nangjung. I cannot let you live.” 

Ambushed and standing on the brink of death, Baek Yang Hwi despairs that he has yet to establish his family as a great clan. But just as all hope seems lost, he finds himself opening his eyes to an impossible reality. 

“Did I really return to when I was eight years old?” 

His family is third-rate, but his talent is unmatched throughout history. Starting his life anew, he vows that this time he will make his family the greatest clan in the entire world.
description.es:
—Lo siento, el mejor espadachín entre los vagabundos. Tu talento es demasiado peligroso.
Mientras intentaba elevar a su clan marcial de tercera clase a una familia prominente, fue emboscado y asesinado. O al menos, eso fue lo que pensó.
—¿Pero qué demonios...? ¿Por qué tengo ocho años?
Puede que el clan sea de tercera clase, pero su talento es el más grande de todos los tiempos. ¡En esta segunda oportunidad en la vida, está decidido a convertirse en el número uno bajo el cielo con su clan marcial!
description.fa: «همون‌طور که از برترین شمشیرزن نانگ‌جونگ انتظار می‌رفت... نمی‌تونم بذارم زنده بمونی.» بک یونگ‌هو در یک حمله‌ی غافلگیرانه گرفتار شده بود و حالا تا یک قدمی مرگ پیش رفته بود. در آخرین لحظات عمرش، چیزی جز حسرت براش باقی نمونده بود. حتی نتونسته بود به هدفی که تمام عمرش براش جنگیده بود برسه؛ اینکه خاندان گمنامش رو به جایگاه یک خاندان بزرگ برسونه. قرار بود داستان زندگی‌اش همین‌جا تموم بشه. اما... «یعنی... واقعاً برگشتم به زمانی که هشت سالم بود؟» خاندانش شاید فقط یک خاندان رزمی درجه‌سه و در پایین‌ترین رده قرار داشت، اما استعداد خود یونگ‌هو چیزی فراتر از حد تصور بود؛ استعدادی بی‌سابقه و بی‌رقیب. حالا که سرنوشت یک فرصت دوباره بهش داده بود، یونگ‌هو عهد کرد: این بار، خاندان حقیرش رو به بزرگ‌ترین خاندان بهشتی تبدیل می‌کنه!
description.id: Dulu, keluarga ini cuma jadi bahan ejekan di dunia persilatan. Reputasi jeblok, utang menumpuk, dan para tetangga sudah pasrah menunggu bubar jalan. Ketika sang pewaris pulang dari perantauan dengan kepala dingin dan rencana matang, ia menemukan petunjuk warisan teknik lama yang selama ini terkubur, lalu mulai merombak latihan, disiplin, dan cara berpikir seluruh klan. Langkah pertama: bertahan hidup. Langkah berikutnya: bikin semua orang berhenti meremehkan. Perlahan tapi pasti, mereka menembus intrik sekte, politik pedagang, sampai permainan kotor bangsawan. Setiap duel membuka pintu ke aliansi baru, setiap bisnis kecil menambal kas, dan setiap rahasia terpecahkan menaikkan pamor keluarga. Ambisinya jelas, jadi bukan cuma kuat di kampung halaman, tapi menancapkan nama sebagai yang terhebat di bawah langit, tanpa kehilangan hati dan prinsip di tengah badai kekuasaan.

Я не могу оставить тебя в живых»Пэк Ян-хви попадает в засаду и оказывается на грани смерти.А ведь он ещё даже не успел превратить свой род в великий клан…По крайней мере, так всё и должно было закончиться.«Неужели я действительно вернулся в свои восемь лет?»Его род — всего лишь третьесортный.Зато его талант — величайший за всю историю.Получив шанс начать жизнь заново, Ян-хви решает:— На этот раз я сделаю эту семью величайшей в мире!
description.pt-br: "Como esperado do Maior Espada de Nangjung. Não posso permitir que você viva." Emboscado e levado ao limite absoluto da morte, os momentos finais de Baek Yang-Hui são consumidos por um amargo arrependimento. Ele nem sequer havia alcançado o objetivo de sua vida: elevar sua obscura família ao prestigioso status de um Grande Clã. Aparentemente, esse seria o fim de sua história. Mas então... "Eu realmente regredi para quando tinha oito anos de idade?" Sua família pode ser de um clã marcial de terceira categoria, da mais baixa categoria, mas seu próprio talento é sem precedentes e inigualável. Agraciado com uma milagrosa segunda chance na vida, Yang-Hui faz um juramento solene: desta vez, ele transformará sua humilde família no Maior Clã Sob os Céus.

description.en: In a world where awakening makes anyone a hero, one "trash-tier" Necromancer commands a microscopic undead army that will bring the world to its knees.

"Would you like to live once again?" 

It was a peaceful and normal life an average person would live. Getting a job, meeting ‘the one’ and getting married, then living life with your own loving family. I was living that life. 

Then I got an offer to start life again.

 The excitement of starting life once again quickly faded away. Faced with the fading memories of my past life, growing fainter and fainter as each day passed by; the fear of not being able to meet my wife and daughter overwhelmed me. To make matters worse, the opportunity to become an actor, a dream that I had given up before, was tempting… 

"If I live this life differently from my previous one, there’s a chance that I might not be able to meet my wife and daughter!"

Stuck between family and the dream I had given up, what will be my choice?

Having achieved everything, he now only wants peace and quiet. Upon finding his way back home to Earth, he expects just that… only to face the most daunting quest of his life: raising a daughter. Can a man who once ruled kingdoms and overthrew rulers conquer fatherhood?

A princess, neglected by her father, the emperor, decides to take the throne after his sudden death. But when he unexpectedly returns alive, their already strained relationship turns into a battle of wits and wills.

description.en: Everyone believes Edith Reynolds is broken after her own family brands her a madwoman. They bury the truth, and her mother, beneath rumors and polite smiles. But when she’s engaged to Grayson Riley Myers, the kingdom’s perfect duke and third prince, Edith finally gains the chance she needs to take revenge. Their marriage begins as nothing more than a contract, each intending to use the other, but beneath their calculated alliance spring feelings neither of them expected. As Edith uncovers her family’s deadly schemes, can she survive their betrayal and outwit the very people who destroyed her?

description.en: Salvo Vigali, a nenowned Italian author, has spent the past three years in Florida, yet he still hasn’t managed to learn even the basics of English. Despite his literary acclaim, he’s chosen to disappear into a shabby motel, letting himself fade as he waits for someone he can’t seem to release from his heart. He aches for Sicily, and that longing sharpens when he meets Ben, a scrappy motel cleaner whose thick Sicilian accent feels like a lifeline to the home Salvo misses. Drawn to that sense of belonging, Salvo soon hires Ben to be both his assistant and his English tutor, setting the stage for an unexpected bond between them.

description.en: Just before graduating from university, a woman suddenly finds herself transported into another world. Until she can find a way home, she decides to enjoy everything she missed while studying especially romance. When a handsome but painfully shy nerd moves in next door, she decides he is the perfect choice. The problem is, he may actually be the infamous Magic Tower Master, a man known for his terrifying personality. Still, that seems like a minor concern compared to the truth she soon discovers: the world she thought belonged to a romance novel is actually a deadly survival story where something is trying to kill her.
description.pt-br:
Eu fui parar dentro de um romance pouco antes de terminar a pós-graduação.
Enquanto não encontrasse uma maneira de voltar ao meu mundo, decidi aproveitar um pouco das coisas que tinha deixado de lado por causa dos estudos.
Como namorar. Namorar. Ou, quem sabe, namorar.
Por sorte, o homem que acabou de se mudar para a casa ao lado faz exatamente o meu tipo. Então decidi que estava na hora de começar um romance com o vizinho.

“P-Posso continuar com o manto? É que… fico com vergonha de mostrar o rosto…”

Bom, ele é um nerd que não larga o manto, assim como um universitário de engenharia não larga sua camisa xadrez.

“...Se eu fosse o mestre da Torre Mágica, você me abandonaria?”

Esse nerd parece ser a mesma pessoa que o mestre da Torre Mágica, conhecido por ser um psicopata de personalidade completamente insana.

Mas isso não deve ser um problema tão grande, certo?
Não quando comparado ao fato de que o mundo do romance onde eu achava que tinha entrado é, na verdade, uma história de terror e sobrevivência em que estão tentando me matar.

The protagonist, once an assistant manager on Daeyoung Corporation’s Spain team, is forced into a transfer to distribution after having their achievements stolen by superiors. There, He begins working as the personal secretary to Kang Mun-jeong, the only legitimate heir of the Daeyoung Group.

Feeling her position threatened, Executive Director Kang Mun-jeong proposes a contract marriage to the protagonist, Yoon Tae-sik, who has served faithfully at her side for three years, in order to once again draw public attention to herself.

The price of the marriage: 10 billion won.

Compared to 30 years ago, the Jaekyung Group has noticeably declined. Son Joong-gil is determined to restore the group he built back to its former glory.

Brienne is deprived of her title by her cousin and is in danger of being sold off to an ugly middle-aged aristocrat. So she dressed as a man and ran away, but the difficulty of finding a job was serious. The only good-paying job she found was a butler of the notoriously vicious Duke of Connate!
"The weekly salary is 2 gold!"

description.en:
I reincarnated as the villainess in a book!  
The one who dared to commit attempted murder on the heroine is the owner of this body?  
  
Let’s just live in a quiet place where we have fun and eat! That’s what I thought for a while.  
It was so, so, so cold here in the north, where I was kicked out as a punishment.  
Before I froze to death, I called the Great Demon of Fire and set fire to the fireplace but…  
  
Why isn’t he going back? If you’ve done the job, shouldn’t you go back?!  
I was flustered to find out that I had signed a life contract with a demon just to start a fire but to think that I’d be responsible for relieving his desires!  
  
The bickering romance between a big puppy demon and a small villainess lady!

description.ru:
Главная героиня - злодейка, осужденная за свои злодеяния. Сосланная в далекие края на север, она вынуждена выживать в суровых условиях.  
Рискуя умереть от холода, девушка призывает демона, чтобы он помог ей поджечь отсыревшие дрова.  
- Ты позвала меня, чтобы всего лишь зажечь огонь?  
- Да, просто сделай это поскорее.  
Но демон оказался неиссякаемым источником неприятностей.  
- Раз ты призвала меня, то должна понести ответственность.  
- Понести ответственность? Но с какой стати?  
- Контракт пожизненный.  
История злодейки, которая мечтает о мирной жизни, и демоне Теохарисе, который мечтает, чтобы их контракт был исполнен.
